claim: Decisions put to the person in the sessions' own jargon, as long numbered tails on chat replies, cost a round trip each time; a plain-recap rule removes most of it.

metric.what: Prompts from the person containing explain / what is this / which? items, by day, before and after a recap rule; highest item number in their numbered replies.

countedFrom.machine: one Windows 11 machine; one master, 8 orchestrators, about 50 short-lived workers, one person
versions: agent harness as installed in the period (exact version not recorded)

proposedChange: Decisions go only to a decisions list, each with a plain-words recap; orchestrators file to it directly. The recap rule belongs in the protocol, not in one master's memory.
whyItGeneralises: Questions put to a person in a team's own jargon cost a round trip anywhere; a recap rule is a protocol change any fleet can adopt.
limits: Keyword patterns over three days; day 3 had fewer decision lists.
